comingLast.roast: in on 21 - do not let him near the carpark or a phone
on 19 with 4 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
2 more points and the problem becomes Rava's problem
the blue balls are patient - 4 holes is nothing to them
on 20 with 4 to play - Rava is quietly cheering against him
sitting 1 above Rava and driving very, very carefully
in on 2 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
done and dangling 2 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe by 2 unless the course gets generous late
finished 3 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
